result.brief: 提出 MFlow 自适应参数化（在 x0 与速度预测间按主方向插值）及 ConvRefiner 高频补偿模块，在像素空间扩散 Transformer 上验证，含 UCF-101 视频与文生图实验。
result.reason: Pixel-space diffusion transformer parameterization study with video (UCF-101) and text-to-image experiments; touches representation choice but no learned latent/encoder contribution.
